name: Reach MCP
description: Operate a real LinkedIn account from an AI agent: inbox, invitations, network, Sales Navigator search in plain language, posts and engagement. 58 tools, 6 playbooks served as prompts, jobs that run a batch over working hours inside the quotas, daily quotas enforced server-side, structured errors, idempotent writes, signed webhooks. LinkedIn only. OAuth 2.1 or API key; 7-day trial.
author: Kanbox

tools.name: reach_playbooks
tools.description: START HERE. Return the catalogue of ready-made LinkedIn playbooks — what this server can actually accomplish, as named workflows rather than raw endpoints. Each entry carries its tool sequence, its prerequisites, and the full instructions to run it. Call this first when the user asks what you can do with their LinkedIn account, or when a request is vague. Pass playbook_id to get one playbook's instructions and then follow them.

playbook_id.description: Id of one playbook from the catalogue, to get its full instructions.

include_instructions.description: Also return the full instruction text of every playbook (longer output).

Use type='geo' to resolve a location to its REGION id (the only reliable way — LinkedIn region ids are not enumerable), and type='company' / 'school' / 'title' for those entity facets. Returns [{id, displayValue, headline}]. Feed the chosen id into salesnav_build_search_url (region / current_company / school / current_title). Requires a connected account.

account_id.description: Reach id of the LinkedIn account to act on, from list_accounts.

tools.name: salesnav_build_search_url
tools.description: Build a Sales Navigator people-search URL from structured lead-search filters, using as many filters as the request implies. RESOLUTION: `industry` accepts numeric ids OR names (auto-resolved via the taxonomy); `region` accepts numeric REGION ids OR location names (auto-resolved via geo typeahead — needs account_id). If a name is ambiguous, the tool returns {needs_disambiguation:[...]} with candidates instead of a URL — re-call with the chosen id. BOOLEAN: `keywords` and `current_title` accept LinkedIn boolean syntax (AND/OR/NOT, quotes, parentheses). EXCLUSION: any list value may be an object {id|name, exclude:true}. Set execute=true to also run the first page of results (reuses the live search) and return leads.

account_id.description: Required when passing location/industry NAMES or execute=true.

keywords.description: Global keyword search; supports boolean operators.

current_title.description: Current job title; free text + boolean (e.g. '(CTO OR "VP Engineering") NOT interim').

past_title.description: Boolean search on past job titles.

company_type.description: COMPANY_TYPE: C=Public P=Privately Held N=Non Profit D=Educational S=Partnership E=Self-Employed O=Self Owned G=Government.

function.description: FUNCTION 1-26: 1 Accounting 4 Business Dev 8 Engineering 10 Finance 12 HR 13 IT 15 Marketing 18 Operations 19 Product 25 Sales 26 Support (etc.).

seniority_level.description: SENIORITY: 320 Owner/Partner 310 CXO 300 VP 220 Director 210 Exp. Manager 200 Entry Manager 130 Strategic 120 Senior 110 Entry 100 Trainee.

relationship.description: RELATIONSHIP: F=1st S=2nd A=Group members O=3rd+.

profile_language.description: ISO 639-1 codes: en fr es de it pt nl ...

industry.description: Industry ids (use salesnav_resolve_industry) or names to auto-resolve. Items may be {id|name, exclude}.

region.description: REGION ids (use salesnav_typeahead type=geo) or location names to auto-resolve. Items may be {id|name, exclude}.

past_company.description: Past companies: names or ids; add exclude:true to exclude one.

follows_your_company.description: Only people who follow your company page.

viewed_your_profile.description: Only people who viewed your profile recently.

with_shared_experiences.description: Only people with shared experiences (school, company, group).

recently_changed_jobs.description: Only people who changed jobs in the last 90 days.

posted_on_linkedin.description: Only people who posted on LinkedIn in the last 30 days.

execute.description: Also run the first results page and return leads.

tools.name: create_webhook_endpoint
tools.description: Register a URL to be called when something happens on LinkedIn, so an agent or an n8n/Make workflow can react instead of polling. Returns the signing secret ONCE; deliveries carry 'Reach-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, t + '.' + body)>'. Events: message.received, connection.new, account.status_changed, quota.threshold_reached, quota.reached, or '*' for all. Omit account_ids to subscribe for every account of the user. https only.

url.description: https URL that accepts a JSON POST.

account_ids.description: Optional: only these LinkedIn account ids.

description.description: Free-text label for your own reference.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A key you choose (a UUID is fine) that names this exact call. If you retry with the same key and the same arguments, the first call's result is returned and nothing is done twice on LinkedIn. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused. Keys expire after 24 hours.

tools.name: create_job
tools.description: Queue a batch of LinkedIn actions (messages, invitations, profile visits or comments) that Reach executes on its own over the following hours or days: spread across the account's activity window (set per account with update_account_quotas; default 09:00-18:00, Monday to Friday, in the account's timezone; overridable per job) with human-like gaps, never beyond the daily quota of the action. Returns immediately with a job_id and the planned schedule; the agent does not have to stay alive. The job pauses by itself when a quota is reached or the account disconnects and resumes when it can; webhooks job.started / job.progress / job.paused / job.completed report what happens. Use it for anything above a handful of actions instead of calling send_message or connect in a loop. Always show the user the items before queuing them.

account_id.description: Reach id of the LinkedIn account to act on, from list_accounts.

action.description: What every item does. send_message: text + conversation_linkedin_id (reply) or recipient_linkedin_id (new thread). connect: linkedin_id_or_url + optional message (<200 chars). visit_profile: linkedin_id_or_url. comment_post: post_url_or_urn + text.

items.description: One object per action, in the order to execute them; fields depend on the action (see action).

label.description: Short free text shown in the dashboard and in webhook events, e.g. 'Follow-ups week 40'.

window_start.description: HH:MM in the job's timezone; default: the account's window (09:00 unless changed).

window_end.description: HH:MM in the job's timezone; default: the account's window (18:00 unless changed).

days.description: Weekdays the job may run: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun. Default: the account's window (Monday to Friday unless changed).

timezone.description: IANA zone such as Europe/Paris. Default: the account's window setting, else the zone of its proxy country.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A key you choose (a UUID is fine) that names this exact call. If you retry with the same key and the same arguments, the first call's result is returned and nothing is done twice on LinkedIn. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused. Keys expire after 24 hours.
